headline: Crude Oil Futures Rise Following Reports of Houthi Attack in Riyadh
summary: January Brent oil futures rose 0.50% to $92.44 per barrel, while WTI futures gained 0.56% to $82.90. The price increase followed reports of a Houthi attack targeting Riyadh.
why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East directly impacts global oil price benchmarks due to potential supply disruptions in key producing countries.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Futures rose on heightened geopolitical risks in Saudi Arabia.
